description: This file handles the routing setup for an admin UI, specifically re-exporting components and types from Next.js router and link modules to ensure consistency across packages. It also defines custom link and head components for use within the application.

methods.name: Link
methods.description: A wrapper component around Next.js's Link component, provided for use in the admin UI to maintain consistency.

methods.name: Head
methods.description: A component wrapping Next.js's Head, used to manage the document head within the UI.
